name: COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive engineering services, including design consultation, mechanical and electrical system implementation, and project contracting. These offerings support engineering initiatives across the grain, oil, and cold chain sectors. Additionally, the company manufactures specialized equipment for grain and oil processing, featuring products such as mills, high square sieves, drying machinery, and oil extraction apparatus. The firm was founded on March 31, 1993, and is based in Wuxi, China.
